records.failureSummary: Added test/store.test.mjs with 10 AC-numbered store unit tests (AC-S1-1..AC-S1-5 plus regression). Coverage: title-only, done-only and combined title+done partial updates (AC-S1-1); patch-absent fields id/untouched title+done preserved, including an empty patch {} (AC-S1-2); update return value deep-equals store.get and store.list entry (AC-S1-3); update and remove on a missing id return falsy without throwing (AC-S1-4); remove deletes the target, remaining items stay readable via get/list, and a second remove is falsy without throwing (AC-S1-5); plus regression assertions on existing list/create (add/get/list, auto-increment ids, empty list, get miss -> null). Red-first evidence: the identical assertions run against a scratch copy of the pre-implementation placeholder store yielded 9 fail / 1 pass, all failures being 'update/remove 尚未实现'; the scratch copy lived only in sandbox /tmp and was removed. Green: full node --test suite is 12 tests / 12 pass / 0 fail / 0 errors. npm run build and npm run lint both exit 0. No product code was modified by this task (the src/store.mjs update/remove implementation is pre-existing from BACKEND T3/T4). Note: pnpm is not installed in the sandbox, so the literal 'pnpm test' cannot be executed; package.json test maps to node --test, run here via npm test (identical script).
